actual_scope: Complete standard 3–6-player John Company: Second Edition (2022), Rules of Play Second Printing 2023: 1710, 1758, 1813 and Long 1710, including core deregulation/firms. Crown/solo/two-player and optional Draft excluded. Individual component powers, starting holdings and exact scenario maps remain lookup material. Includes the explicitly user-adopted general defense-strength interpretation.

authority_qualification.official: Original supplied Second Printing rulebook, original publisher-linked PnP board/cards, applicable official correction list/original post and supplied designer originals. These were inspected directly; prior audits and the verification banner were not evidence.
authority_qualification.human: The general newly exhausted defense strength ≥ attack comparison is accepted solely as the explicitly attributed user interpretation in the two original human-authority files. The public designer Foreign Invasion and Fraud rulings are separate authorities.

verdict_explanation: No material source conflict or consequential common-procedure omission found after reading the entire 499-LF candidate, every original multiplayer rulebook LF through printed42, the full correction texts, both human records, designer originals and relevant original component visuals. The defense threshold is not asserted to be independently verified official text. Eighty-one manually assessed claim groups cover the retained material rule claims and source references. This conclusion applies to the stated component-assisted summary, not a replacement for individual card powers/maps.

accepted_scope_variation.candidate_exact_quote:
| Total strength of newly exhausted pieces | Attack and defense result |
|---|---|
| **EQUAL TO OR GREATER THAN** Crisis strength | **The attack FAILS; defense SUCCEEDS.** Remove all unrest in the attacked region. The **actual Commander gains one trophy**; **Military Affairs/Chairman substitutes gain OR lose NO trophies**. If this defeated a normal primary Invasion, also remove one attacker tower if possible. |
| **LESS THAN** Crisis strength | **The attack SUCCEEDS; defense FAILS.** Perform Region Loss. If the successful primary Crisis was an Invasion, apply empire creation/growth. |

**Example:** Exhausting an active strength-2 local alliance successfully defends a strength-1 Crisis. Exhaust the whole alliance piece; its excess strength does not cause the defense to fail.
accepted_scope_variation.printed_official_exact_quote:
Ƙ Mounting Defense. The Commander associated with the region 
must exhaust pieces in the Army equal to the strength of the Crisis 
or as many as possible. If the newly-exhausted pieces do not equal 
the strength of the Crisis, the Crisis succeeds. Perform the steps of 
Region Loss (page 29).
accepted_scope_variation.human_exact_quote:
"messages_in_order": [
    "I got an answer! The publisher says that as long as the strength of the exhausted pieces used in defense is equal to or greater than the attacking strength, the Crisis fails. Does that answer your question?",
    "It was in an email.",
    "Just accept my answer. You can note it as my interpretation."
  ],
  "normative_authority_for_summary": "User-approved interpretation: total newly exhausted defense strength equal to or greater than attack makes the Crisis fail. Attribute to user.",
  "publisher_email_independently_verified": false
accepted_scope_variation.assessment: PASS fidelity: the accepted threshold is total strength of newly exhausted pieces equal to OR greater than attack, including overshooting with an indivisible alliance. It is clearly labeled user-supplied at the procedure and in a dedicated attribution section. This is an intentional scoped authority difference, not an unresolved official-source finding.

important_omission_review.assessment: No consequential common setup omission found. Initial figures for every scenario, extra-card counts, complete holdings placement, corrected control/share tokens, map-copy instruction and Long deregulation are present. Exact scenario map pieces and individual dealt holdings may be read from cards as permitted.
Attrition/fatigue/destinations, retirement spending/windows/display exhaustion/refill, restrictions/discounts, forced prize-piece reuse, extra-action timing and debt/share conversion retained.

All standard candidate pools, nepotism, promotions, fallback elections, vacant offices, operation order, optional/mandatory actions, costs, destinations, retry and success limits reviewed. Military Oversight is an individual law exception to ordinary Commander appointment, available on the card; the retained correction is accurate.

Every standard event, stack-versus-Elephant location, storm exceptions, cascade limits, empire decline, Invasion/Rebellion classification, primary/secondary strengths, substitute defense actors, trophy exclusions, Region Loss destinations/escalation, single Foreign Invasion closure and March redirects retained. The accepted user defense comparison is separately attributed.
Full expense/loan/expectation/dividend order, maximum Debt loans, policy/vote timing and consequences, card vote exhaustion, tax destinations, upkeep, refresh and all end timing exceptions retained.

Full core system checked: formation/investment limits and bank funding, two treasuries, owner consent/prices, hostile takeover, merger/dissolution, secret strategies and open bid amounts, one attempt, initiative/filling limits, expenses/rescues, actual dividends, special retirement and final aggregate rounding.

Transfer legality, family replacement on shares, immediate binding agreements, future promises, repeated activation, no game-over negotiation/promises, power awards, Court/workshop success/failure effects, firms-before-normal scoring, random failure card and tie order retained.

Exact individual law/spouse/promise/failure powers and scenario maps intentionally remain component lookups. Every retained corrected-card claim was checked against original errata and native fronts. Examples of component overrides, such as Royal Protection, Military Oversight and Industry’s Greed Condemned, are not interpreted as absent merely because the generic procedures do not reprint every card.

limitations: This is a source audit, not a blind-reader or gameplay test.
No private publisher email was accessed or independently verified.
Exact individual component effects/holdings/maps are permitted lookup material and not reproduced exhaustively by the candidate.
The supplied ancillary PNGs were hashed but not substituted for native original PDF inspection.
Model/effort and independence attestation at the orchestration level must be verified by the parent; this report does not self-certify hidden runtime settings.
